messages:
ash: FYI ACME reported an embeddings regression this morning — vectors/sec dropped ~60% starting 07:12 UTC, tokens/sec steady. raising to eng.
priya: ack, can you paste the customer sample and metric snapshots?
ash: pasted below. short summary: vecs_per_sec went from ~1800 -> ~700. tokens_per_sec ~ unchanged. latency p95 for /v1/embeddings jumped from 120ms -> 420ms. auth/billing looks ok (no 4xx spikes).
ash: customer sample (redacted):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' -d '{"model":"embed-lite-v1","input":["a","b","c",... ]}' -w '\ntime_total:%{time_total}\n'
```
response times: time_total ~0.28s pre-regression, ~0.95s during incident.
maria: any recent rollouts for embed-lite-v1 or routing?
ash: nothing on our ticketing schedule but routing policy did change around 07:05 — small change to prefer quantized variants when dim==null.
leo: that sounds suspicious — do we have logs showing dim headers?
ash: yes, attached log snippet from request-proxy (sanitized):
```
2026-03-16T07:11:58Z INFO request id=abc123 customer_id=acme model=embed-lite-v1 input_count=64 input_dim=768
2026-03-16T07:12:01Z INFO request id=def456 customer_id=acme model=embed-lite-v1 input_count=1 input_dim=0  <-- malformed
2026-03-16T07:12:01Z INFO router route=quantized-embed variant=embed-lite-v1-q reason=dim-missing
```
maria: note the single-item requests with input_dim=0 — those force tiny batches and trigger the quantized variant fallback (we batch by dim+shape). That would reduce batch efficiency and push more tiny kernels onto GPUs.
priya: metrics-bot, can you show gpu_util, avg_batch_size, and queue_depth for embed-lite-v1 around 07:10-07:20?
metrics-bot: gpu_util (p99): 07:05=42%, 07:10=45%, 07:12=87%, 07:15=85% | avg_batch_size: 07:05=48, 07:12=7 | queue_depth: 07:05=120, 07:12=610
leo: queue_depth spiked x5 and avg_batch_size collapsed — classic thundering tiny-batch effect. That explains vectors/sec drop and p95 up.
ash: customer says they didn't change input generation. their payload is from a nightly sync; maybe a transformation started emitting empty records.
maria: two attack vectors: 1) bad client inputs _or_ 2) our router mis-classifying shapes when input_count==1 and missing dims. We should repro locally with same mix.
ash: repro plan: generate mixed workload with 95% normal (64x768) and 5% broken (1x0) at same overall QPS and replay against staging.
priya: also, add a temporary guard: if input_dim==0 treat as expected dim 768 instead of routing to quantized fallback until we fix root cause. That will preserve batch packing.
leo: caution: forcing dim may mask real dimension mismatches with other models. Only do for embed-lite-v1 and only as short rollback.
maria: I can push a small router-rule hotfix (staging -> prod) that maps dim=0 -> 768 for this model for next 2 hours. I'll include metric gating to auto-revert if error-rate or quality regressions appear.
ash: also seeing a small increase in kvcache-lock-waits in logs around same time:
```
2026-03-16T07:12:02Z WARN kvcache lock-wait=125ms key=shard-23
2026-03-16T07:12:02Z WARN kvcache lock-wait=132ms key=shard-42
```
maria: small batches mean more frequent KV cache churn — that can amplify GPU wait. Fixing batching should reduce lock contention.
eng-support: customer is asking for repro steps and ETA. what's our ETA for hotfix?
priya: maria can push hotfix in ~18min, then we'll monitor for 30m. If that recovers, we'll coordinate with customer and do a postmortem.
maria: deploying hotfix to canary now. config diff: `route_match: {model: embed-lite-v1, input_dim: 0} -> route_dim=768`
maria: canary logs show immediate change: 07:31 canary avg_batch_size -> 44, queue_depth -> 110, gpu_util -> 46%
metrics-bot: canary -> prod rollout 07:35. prod avg_batch_size back to 46 by 07:38, vecs_per_sec recovered from 720 -> 1760 by 07:40, latency p95 back to ~130ms.
ash: customer confirmed improvement at 07:42. they traced it to a bug in their ETL emitting blank rows after a schema change. They've deployed a fix on their side.
priya: next actions:
- maria to keep temporary router guard for 2 hours, then revert once customer patch is verified (owner: maria)
- eng-infra (leo) to add alert for avg_batch_size drop >30% for any embeddings model (owner: leo)
- support (ash) to follow up with customer for RCA + impact summary (owner: ash)
- eng-ml (maria) to write a test in the router that treats dim=0 as suspicious and emits a metric (owner: maria)
ash: adding to incident board and creating follow-up ticket. closing thread for now, will update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
metrics-bot: incident created ID=INC-2026-1123, severity=low, linked-customer=acme
priya: great work team, nice triage and fast rollback. :heart:
eng-support: noted, will send the postmortem template to acme and attach logs.
